title: lithospermum arvense subsp. incrassatum
intro: Lithospermum arvense subsp. incrassatum, commonly known as Blue Spurred Gromwell, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Boraginaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Blue Spurred Gromwell include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit potential antiviral activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lithospermum arvense subsp. incrassatum include lithospermic acid, caulerpin, and other flavonoids and alkaloids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
